blockers: At native 192x192 presentation, the face collapses into a pale oval with nearly illegible eyes and mouth; the character loses facial identity at the contracted standing size.
The signature gesture is not visually distinct from the idle cycle. The arm and rapier changes are too small to communicate a deliberate, controlled action.
The lower body is materially muddy: black boots, trousers, corset shadow, and sword overlap into a single low-contrast mass.
The locomotion cycles lack clear contact, passing, and high-point poses. Several feet appear to change position without enough corresponding body weight transfer, risking foot sliding.
The front-facing silhouette is excessively symmetrical and narrow, making the character read as a rigid mannequin rather than a restrained but intentional duelist.
high_value_changes: Redesign the face for 128px sprite readability: enlarge the eye separation and mouth mark, establish a clearer hairline or head silhouette, and remove low-value facial pixels that vanish at native scale.

Strengthen the silhouette rhythm with a more explicit high collar, shoulder contour, waist break, skirt or coat flare, and separated rapier profile. Do not rely on interior blue shading to define the body.

Separate materials by value before hue: lift the navy armor from the obsidian trousers, reserve near-black for recesses, and make brass trim readable as discrete accents rather than scattered yellow pixels.

Rebuild the gesture as a readable four-part action: compressed anticipation, decisive rapier or arm extension, controlled overshoot, then a visibly settled pose. Keep the final pose distinct from idle.
Audit every locomotion direction at native scale and enforce stable foot contacts. The torso should counter-shift subtly while the planted foot remains anchored through contact frames.
Reduce excessive glossy gradients. Use fewer, more intentional highlight bands so the sprite retains SaGa-like graphic shape language instead of becoming a blurred 3D render at 1x.
optional_notes: The 4x nearest-neighbor sheet exposes broad soft-looking value transitions and noisy highlight clusters that are easy to miss in the tiny native previews.
The white hands and pale face compete for attention and flatten the intended midnight palette; the hands should be smaller, more deliberately shaped, or value-linked to the gloves.
Rear and oblique views lose the character's defining collar and torso structure, so directional recognition currently depends too heavily on the blue color block.
The idle strip appears to contain mostly micro-variation rather than a controlled breathing rhythm with clear compression and release.
regressions_from_previous: No prior-round sheet was supplied, so direct frame-to-frame regression verification is not possible.

Relative to the stated intent, the current result still shows an unresolved regression of identity: the restrained duelist concept is being expressed as static symmetry and rendering polish rather than readable pose design.
strongest_improvements: Standing height and ground anchoring meet the technical contract cleanly.
The midnight navy and brass concept is present and remains directionally consistent across the grid.
The rapier is retained across views and provides a usable basis for a stronger silhouette gesture.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the signature gesture and its silhouette as a clearly staged rapier action, then tune the face and lower-body values at native scale so the character remains identifiable without enlargement.
